title: Crucial-Diff: A Unified Diffusion Model for Crucial Image and Annotation Synthesis in Data-Scarce Scenarios
mechanism: A weakness-aware sample miner uses downstream model feedback to steer diffusion toward hard-to-detect samples, fused with a scene-agnostic feature extractor.
adaptation: Feedback = house-model per-pixel loss on generated crack/inactive; hard targets are cracks under 2% contrast, BMRK inactive, CFVS cells without a train twin, half-cut scuff cells; combine with GDI canvases.
min_experiment: Generator with loss feedback vs same generator unguided, matched count, on PF. Metric CV inactive IoU and test relR@2 on cracks < 2% contrast. Kill: < +0.01 over unguided.
evidence: R: MVTec pixel AP 83.63, F1-max 78.12; polyp mIoU 81.64, mDice 87.69.

alt_notes.adaptation: Feedback = house per-pixel loss; hard targets = cracks under 2% contrast, BMRK inactive, CFVS without twin, scuffed half-cut cells; pair with GDI canvases.
